reviews.comment: This class is extremely difficult, and Welsh does not make it any easier. There is no practice exams, rarely only a slight review. The may be out of the textbook which she barely ever mentions. Her lectures are 1:1 copies of Asher Roberts YT videos. Her explanation to questions are good and she is easy to reach. She is nice but don't call her Mrs?

Good professor, easy to reach outside of class through email and office hours, and gives great lectures and understanding. Gives really great feedback and help. Class is definitely more difficult compared to regular Math 151 sections. Be prepared for free-response on everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Welsh is an amazing professor, who truly cares about the success of her students. She is easily accessible outside of class, responds to emails, and holds online tutorials. However, be prepared for the difficulty of her class. I have always done well in my math classes, but I struggled to earn an A in this class. Her tests are very difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You are expected to know calculus and physics before you take this class. You'll be doing proofs on the tests and will be expected to know random trivia on tests that Welsh mentioned 8 weeks before in a lecture. Unnecessary hard, just don't take it. I will say, though, Welsh clearly wants her students to succeed. Good professor, bad course.

(Honors) Dr. Welsh is fantastic! She's super nice and clearly wants you to succeed. Office hours were very helpful. Lectures were easy to follow and recorded. However, the exams had proofs and were way harder than the non-honors exams. Even students who had taken Calc BC and Calc 3 prior, struggled.

Overall, great professor, difficult class.

MATH 151-H is quite difficult as you need a much stronger knowledge of the material for the proof-like problems on exams than non-honors. Professor Welsh had AMAZING lectures that went very in-depth into many of the nuances necessary to actually understand concepts and theorems. Quizzes can be hard but are great for studying for the exams.

Math 151-H had incredibly hard tests that were based more so on the theory of math and proofs rather than calculations. That being said Dr. Welsh was very accessible outside of the classroom whenever I needed extra help. I went to many office hours and felt that Dr. Welsh wanted to help me succeed in this otherwise very hard course.

Got a 5 on calc BC and took calc 3 in high school, still was a difficult class. If you're up for the challenge of honors calc 1, consider skipping to calc 3 (if you can). A few particularly brutal exams, but she grades generously. Even the smartest full ride students struggled, but calc 1 covers more than AP calc.
This class is great for making friends, were trauma bonded.

WHY ARE YOU TAKING HONORS!!! Do not take honors. This class was way too hard for no reason. I came in having already took BC and is was hard. Welsh is kind and offers extra credit but the tests are very hard and people cried during quizzes. You probably can do well and people did but is it worth the trouble...
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Welsh is, by far and away, one of the best professors I've had. She records her lectures and posts notes and resources online. Homework isn't too heavy and makes sure you're ready for the exam. Her office hours helped me a lot, and she was always eager to help me out!

Dr. Welsh was an amazing professor who cared a lot about their students. She was always eager to answer student's questions and give feedback. Weekly homework was not too difficult and she uploaded all notes to canvas. Would recommend going to office hours frequently and dont be afraid to ask for help!

Professor Welsh is a very kind professor. They gave 2 late passes for homework, as well as being understanding of circumstances. Lectures were recorded and posted, as attendance was not mandatory. Lectures themselves were pretty straightforward, and exams were as well as long as you went through and completed the homework and review.

Dr Welsh was one of the best math professor I've had so far at Texas A&M. Overall the class wasn't too difficult and as long as you completed the homework and did some practice exams you will easily pass the class. Would highly recommend taking her if you're able to get a seat.

Dr. Welsh is an amazing professor! They made themselves accessible outside of material very effectively, and were very accommodating to student's needs. There is no professor I would sooner recommend to my peers for any math class!

Dr Welsh is certainly a kind professor and does as much as she can to help you if you reach out. Lectures are solid, sometimes homework has errors in them, but mostly a great professor. Sometimes her notes are a bit confusing, but lecture recording is always available and posted 10 mins after. She gives topic reviews of whats expected for exam

Prof records all lectures so attendance wasn't mandatory. Her lectures were really informative and made it easy to solve the homework problems. She would also review right before our exam which helped a lot. The exams weren't too difficult as long as you understood what you were doing on the homework. She also gives 2 late hw passes which were nice
